# ESLint configuration artifacts

These are the two private config packages requested for this branch, downloaded through the GitHub App from the successful **CI and package archives** run [38587698293](https://github.com/notmike101/eslint-configs/actions/runs/38587698293), commit `48a765fb81a92695b779f9b5d95272dca0a1f402` on `master`.

The upstream repository distributes each package as a workflow artifact rather than a registry release. Keep these archives with the lockfile so `npm ci` works in a fresh checkout. Their normal imports are `@notmike101/eslint-config-js` and `@notmike101/eslint-config-jsdoc`; their rules are consumed directly.

- `notmike101-eslint-config-js-4.1.0.tgz`: `6bf1cde29e1559288d0afb4289f4574634452aed6568a836646745849dd75f58`
- `notmike101-eslint-config-jsdoc-1.0.1.tgz`: `59fcc69a6017616a050a30a401a03745e7a8e98debafe666b4dd874f633ebfae`
